Foreword from the Chairman

2022 was set to be a milestone in the recovery of global economy post-pandemic. However, it also confronted numerous daunting global challenges such as unpredictable climate crisis, global political turmoil, continued ASF, inflation eroding consumers purchasing ability, and ongoing supply chain disruption.

During this volatile year, the Executive Board at GREENFEED firmly took action to ensure normal business operations and proactively strengthened ties with partners to overcome difficulties and arrive at predetermined goals. In which, ESG considerations remained our top priority. In an effort to transition into a “greener” business, the Group deployed programs of solar power systems, renewable energy, and emission reduction such as using biomass fuel for steam boilers. We also promoted initiatives for preserving natural resources and reducing plastic, contributing to national goals of Net Zero by 2050.

With unwavering determination, GREENFEED was ranked in the Top 100 Sustainable Businesses in Vietnam (CSI 100), a prestigious award organized by the Vietnam Chamber of Commerce and Industry (VCCI) in collaboration with relevant ministries. We considered the award as recognition and motivation for GREENFEED to take even greater strides and become the leading sustainable business in the Food and Agriculture sector.

Throughout 20 years of operation, we have constantly innovated, initiated, and interconnected with stakeholders to build a strong ecosystem upon shared prosperity. We, though always set sight on a clear destination, are very much aware that the path is not always a straight line. For the period of 2025-2030, with a vision toward 2050, The Board of Directors has established business strategy with a focus on green transformation to ensure sustainable growth across the value chain; digital transformation to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency; talent development to develop next generation of leaders.

Looking back on our two-decade journey, we are thankful for the companionship of our valued Shareholders, Partners, and Customers. With our hearts in the right place, and our minds aligned with the vision, we are in full gear to grow GREENFEED even stronger and bring more goodness to the community.

Chairman

Mr. Ly Anh Dung
